metadata.description: A collection of agent skills for Claude

plugins.name: survey-mode
plugins.description: Listen-and-digest mode: Claude only listens, digests, and marks key points during free writing / brain dumps — no advice, no solutions, no converging — until the user calls stop, then delivers an integrated digest board.

plugins.name: swiss-slide-style
plugins.description: Swiss-minimal slide spec with a red (#C00000) + blue (#1912F7) dual-accent semantic system, large-type exec variant, Gantt and wording rules for upward reporting decks.

plugins.name: rolling-plan
plugins.description: Turn a survey into a rolling PLAN.md: start from the end state, detail only the next phase, checkable done-criteria per phase, and a decision log for every turn.

plugins.name: repo-init-adopt
plugins.description: Make a repo agent-ready: init a new one in a fixed shape, or adopt an existing one by auditing and filling in PLAN.md, CIP.md, AGENTS.md and docs/.

plugins.name: cip-loop
plugins.description: Continuous improvement loop: log every finding as one line in CIP.md, pick one per session, verify by running it, and write back to PLAN.md only when direction changes.

plugins.name: agent-dev-flow
plugins.description: The full agent development flow in one install: survey-mode → rolling-plan → repo-init-adopt → cip-loop. Grow any repo into an agent-ready system with the same shape and rhythm.
